source: PostHog execute-sql against the Keating project; all app versions
query: SELECT count() AS captured_events, uniqExact(tuple(JSONExtractString(properties, 'conversation_id'), JSONExtractString(properties, 'turn_id'))) AS distinct_turns FROM events WHERE event = 'openui_turn_observed' AND JSONExtractString(properties, '$host') IN ('keating.help', 'chat.keating.help') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-18 18:30:00', 'UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-19 02:05:00', 'UTC')
taxonomy: PostHog reported that openui_turn_observed was absent from the project taxonomy.
scope: The interval starts at the cutoff in the earlier 4.2.0 query. No eligible production events were available to estimate real-learner usage. The instrumented synthetic classroom sessions have their own Settings and wire receipts.
